purpose: P3.5 final sweep — enumerate every sahool-platform file that still performs direct Open-Meteo wiring (imports api.connectors.openmeteo or calls fetch_current/fetch_daily_forecast/fetch_historical/fetch_weather_tile_data) and pin each to an honest reason. The guard test scans api/**/*.py and fails on any offender that is neither a legitimate home nor a documented residual.

legitimate_homes.api/connectors/openmeteo.py: The Open-Meteo provider adapter itself. The single sanctioned place that speaks to the Open-Meteo HTTP provider (with the circuit breaker). All other platform weather reads should flow through weather-service (via api/weather_service_client.py) or this adapter, not re-open provider transport.
legitimate_homes.api/weather_service_client.py: The P3.4 weather-service boundary transport (weather-service system-of-record). Thin HTTP client the platform uses to reach weather-service; it does NOT import Open-Meteo connectors (so it does not match the markers above) but is listed here as the sanctioned weather transport home.

composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/routers/weather.py: The 9 core weather routes (current/forecast/historical/tile-data/operation-tile-data/operation-window/operation-plan/tile-series/tile-cache-stats) are P3.4 facades to weather-service. Residual LOCAL endpoints (probe, field-weather-summary, alerts) still derive from the provider adapter and are pending P4 facade conversion.
composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/main.py: App-root legacy combined dashboard endpoint still composes current + daily forecast inline; cross-domain composite pending P4 consolidation behind the weather facade.
composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/field_context.py: Cross-domain field-context aggregator: pulls historical weather to enrich phenology/season context alongside soil/raster facts. Not a weather runtime; composite read pending P4.
composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/routers/fields.py: Fields BFF exposes per-field weather summary/forecast by composing current + daily forecast; cross-domain field aggregator pending P4.
composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/routers/etc_dual.py: ETc dual-crop coefficient endpoint composes current + forecast weather with crop coefficients; cross-domain agronomic aggregator pending P4.
composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/routers/field_ai_context.py: Field AI-context builder reads historical weather to ground agronomy/LLM context; cross-domain composite pending P4.
composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/routers/season_workspace.py: Season workspace composes forecast/current weather into the seasonal planning view; cross-domain aggregator pending P4.
composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/routers/seasons.py: Seasons endpoint pulls historical weather for season retrospectives; cross-domain aggregator pending P4.
composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/weather_automation.py: Weather-driven automation/alerts worker polls current weather per configured location; cross-domain automation composite pending P4.
composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/routers/field_workspace_weather.py: Relocated from fields.py (UI27-30 workspace cleanup): irrigation-advice + disease-risk still call connectors.openmeteo (fetch_current/fetch_daily_forecast) directly — same pre-existing residual, pending P4 move behind weather-service.

neutral_tile_guarantee: api/weather_service_client.py get_weather_tile_data/get_operation_tile_data catch a 502 (weather-service unreachable) and return a neutral tile (value=null, available=false, cache_state=service_unavailable) instead of propagating one Bad Gateway per tile. This preserves the pre-extraction 'don't flood the map with 502 per tile' guarantee across the platform->weather-service network hop.
final_sweep_status: P3.5 complete: direct Open-Meteo wiring is pinned to api/connectors/openmeteo.py (provider adapter) + api/weather_service_client.py (weather-service transport); all other referencing files are documented composite_residuals_pending_p4. New offenders are blocked by tests/test_p3_5_weather_direct_wiring_final_sweep.py.
